links.outcome: Readability and understandability (PEMAT) of AI-simplified radiology reports for patients
links.effect: All three models simplified jargon, with BARD showing superior readability scores. All models scored above 70% on understandability, with ChatGPT-4 and BARD leading (p < 0.001, both).
links.quote: All three AI models successfully transformed medical jargon into more accessible language, with BARD showing superior readability scores.

links.outcome: Accuracy of urgency classification from radiology reports by AI models
links.effect: Models varied in accuracy of urgency recommendations, with no significant statistical difference between models (p = 0.284). Authors conclude that urgency assessment needs further refinement.
links.quote: However, the AI models varied in accuracy of urgency recommendations, with no significant statistical difference (p = 0.284).

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4, Bard, Copilot) on simplifying 30 radiology reports for patient readability and urgency classification without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
